description: Issue #286: node local readings retain a capture-expanded site and can complete beyond the chosen span.
grammar:
%rule text [$x:r] "b"
%rule r
 | "a" :: R
 | "a" "b" :: R
%check longer
 #·r
%conditions $.local-readings.ending-after($), R ⊆ $.local-readings.tags
%warning "longer"
%check leaf
 #·_
%conditions $.local-readings.ending-after($)
%warning "bad"
